name: Crewe FMC Day 2025

venue.name: Crewe Alexandra Football Club
venue.address: Mornflake Stadium, Gresty Road, Crewe, Cheshire, CW2 6EB

information: Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** **PLEASE NOTE:** This is a specialist competition. We do not recommend this competition to first time competitors. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. PLEASE NOTE: For this competition, there will be a competitor limit of 16 for Multi-Blind on a first come first serve basis. If you register for Multi-Blind and are not within the first 16 people registered, your registration for the event will be removed. However we will be keeping a waiting list for this specific event in the case of dropouts before the competition. Please only consider registering for this event if you are certain you would like to compete in it. If you are competing in both [Crewe Favourites 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CreweFavourites2025) and [Crewe FMC Day 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CreweFMCDay2025), you'll be eligible for a £10 refund on your registration. For example, competing in one of the two competitions would cost you £20, and competing in both competitions would cost you £40 in registration fee upfront, but £30 in total, as you'll get £10 back after the competition. The winner of Fewest Moves will be announced as the winner of the competition.
